title: Pro Yakyuu Team mo Tsukurou!
native_title: プロ野球チームもつくろう！
overview: Pro Yakyuu Team mo Tsukurou! ("Let's Make a Pro Baseball Team, Too!") is a baseball management simulation game spun off from Sega's better-known soccer management series. Selecting one of the 12 teams from the Japanese professional leagues, the goal is to build that team into the greatest baseball team in the world. Many aspects of managing a team are simulated and under control of the player, from hiring players and staff, determining training schedules and strategies before games, to even managing the team's finances and constructing facilities. The player can also create multiple custom players to sign to their team and train, and it is also possible to host an exhibition match against another player's team using a password function.
